claims.text: Fine-grained entity typing involves assigning multiple semantic types to entities, moving beyond standard coarse types.
The task is approached as a multi-label classification problem, where entities can belong to multiple types simultaneously.
Fine-grained types are drawn from richer ontologies, allowing for more nuanced categorization of entities.
